data.long_meaning: Derived from the Germanic name Theobald, meaning 'servant of God', composed of the elements 'theo-' (God) and 'bald' (brave or ruler). In Christian context, it can be interpreted as 'brave servant of God'. The name Talbot carries the meaning “Brave or Courageous” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Talbot usually hope their child will grow to embody brave or courageous and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Talbot, derived from the Germanic Theobald, carries a deep spiritual significance. Theobald can be translated to 'servant of God', indicating that someone bearing this name is called to serve and dedicate their life to God. This name would have been particularly meaningful to those who held it during the Middle Ages when religious devotion was a central focus of society. Additionally, the name's association with bravery or rule highlights the idea of being a strong and godly ruler or leader. Thus, the Christian name Talbot embodies the virtues of faith, devotion, and service to God, making it a powerful and inspiring name.
